name: Viridescent Dragon: Halloween Special
source:
This is the first Halloween Special for the Viridescent Dragon visual novel series! Join Charlotte, Seleste and Dawn as they try to throw a Halloween Party they'll never forget!

[From [url=https://viridea.itch.io/viridescent-dragon-halloween-special]Itch.io[/url]]

这是青龙视觉小说系列的首个万圣节特辑！与夏洛特、塞莱斯特和黎明一起尝试举办一场他们永远不会忘记的万圣节派对！

[来自[url=https://viridea.itch.io/viridescent-dragon-halloween-special]Itch.io[/url]]
